instruction: Organize your Thunderbird mail by creating local folders for WORK and HOME.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating two local folders in Thunderbird (WORK and HOME). Evaluator checks for both folder files and .msf metadata files. Same complexity as original task with different folder names.
metadata.verification: Verified evaluator checks for WORK and HOME folders and their .msf files using regex patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks the Thunderbird Local Folders directory via postconfig ls -R command
All instruction requirements are covered: both WORK and HOME folders must be created
Regex patterns correctly verify both folder storage files (WORK, HOME) and metadata files (WORK.msf, HOME.msf)
Pattern \bWORK/?(?!\.msf) correctly matches WORK folder while excluding WORK.msf file
Pattern \bHOME/?(?!\.msf) correctly matches HOME folder while excluding HOME.msf file
Separate patterns for .msf files ensure metadata is also verified
check_list metric function correctly validates all expected patterns are found in ls output
State is accessible: ls output captures all created folders and files in the target directory
